_about: Wifecraft's Eve body fit table, read by engine/evebody.cpp (parseEveFitTable): one row per Warcraft female model.
enabled: whether the Eve body is put on that model at all; reason says why not (shown in the menus), quality what the desktop renders showed.
fit: factors on the measured fit (girth: every width over the measured hip and shoulder ratios; torso, hips, shoulders, thigh, calf, arm, forearm: one region's
width; neckTuck, neckLift, neckBase, ankleLift: the seams). Numbers checked in desktop renders only (wifecraft/README.md, The Eve body).

defaults.fit: what every row's fit starts from. Proportions edit the actor's skeleton while she wears Eve (engine/bodyrig.h) at the model's own height: hip joints at hipRatio of her height (0: the model's), hands handHeads head heights long, clavicles spread by spread; heads > 0 would set her height in the model's head heights instead (none does: a shorter body under the game's head reads as a child). transfer: the reach (Sims metres) of the colour transfer that takes her skin's tones from the model's own; stitch: the seams joined to the model's cut-edge vertices.
